other_conditions: Start‑ups must be certified by the Start‑up Promotion Cell (SPC) and have a valid start‑up certificate number
Employees must be hired for a minimum period of 12 months
Bank accounts of employees and directors must be linked to Aadhaar
Expenditures must be incurred after the Goa Start‑up Policy 2017 notification, within its validity, and paid digitally (SPC may allow non‑digital payments after due diligence)
benefits_summary: Reimburses 50% of a fresher's salary up to ₹10,000 per month (or up to 25% of local workforce salary up to ₹25,00,000 per year) for a maximum of 3 years, subject to claim limits.
